spans.s:
(ओ ऌ) औशुधॢ r. 4th cl. (शुध्यति)
To be or become pure or purified.

f. (-धा)
1 Nectar, the beverage of immortality and sustenance of the gods.
2 The nectar or honey of flowers.
3

Juice.
4

Plaster, mortar.
5 A brick.
6 The

Ganges.
7

Water.
8

Lightning.
9

The milk-hedge plant, (Euphorbia antiquorum, &c.)
10 A plant, (Aletris Hyacinthoides.)
11 Emblic myrobalan.
12 Yellow myrobalan.
E.
सु pleasure, धे to drink, or धा to have, to support, (life,) अङ् and टाप् affs.

m. (-न्वा)
1 An archer, a bowman.
2 VIŚVAKARMA, the artist of the gods.
3 A prince so named.
E.
सु good, and धनुम् a bow, अनङ् substituted for the final.

m. (-र्म्मः)
One of the principal disciples of Mahāvīra, the last Jina of the present age; he survived his master, and the different ascetics or candidates for holiness are traced from him in regular succession; none of the other ten disciples of Mahāvīra having left successors.
f. (-र्म्मी)
A council of the gods.
E.
सु excellent, and धर्म्म virtue.

mf. (-र्म्मा)
The council or assembly of the gods.
m. (-र्म्मा)
A man attentive to the proper maintenance of his family.
E.
सु excellent, धर्म्म virtue, अनिच् aff.

m. (-शुः)
1 The moon.
2 Camphor.
E.
सुधा nectar, and अंशु a ray of light, the moon being the supposed repository of the beverage of the gods.

n. (-लं)
Camphorated oil.
E.
सुधांशु Camphor, and तैल oil.

n. (-त्नं)
A pearl.
E.
सुधांशु the moon, and रत्न a jewel.

m. (-रः)
The moon.
E.
सुधा nectar, आकर a mine.

m. (-ङ्गः)
The moon.
E.
सुधा nectar, and अङ्ग body or substance.

m. (-वी)
A bricklayer, a plasterer.
E.
सुधा plaster, and जीविन् who lives by.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
White-washed, stuccoed, plastered.
E.
सुधा, and धवलित whitened.

m. (-रः)
The moon.
E.
सुधा nectar, and आधार a receptacle.

m. (-धिः)
The moon.
E.
सुधा nectar, and निधि a receptacle.

m. (-णिः)
The divine physician, DHANVANTARI.
E.
सुधा nectar, पाणि hand, bearing in his hands the beverage of immortality.

n. (-नं)
1 A stuccoed house.
2 The fifth Muhūrta or hour after noon.
E.
सुधा, and भवन mansion.

m. (-भुक्)
A deity, an immortal.
E.
सुधा nectar, भुज to enjoy, aff. क्विप्.

m. (-तिः)
1 Sacrifice, oblation.
2 The moon.
E.
सुधा nectar, and भृति cherishing.

mfn. (-यः-यी-यं)
1 Made of plaster, &c.
2 Consisting of nectar.
m. (-यः)
A palace, a mansion, a brick or stone building.
E.
सुधा mortar or a brick, and मयट् aff.

m. (-र्षः)
A shower of ambrosia.
E.
सुधा, and वर्ष rain.

m. (-र्षी)
1 A Buddha or deified sage of the Bauddha religion.
2 BRAHMĀ.
E.
सुधा nectar, and वर्षिन् raining.

f. (-ष्टिः)
A shower of ambrosia.
E.
सुधा, and वृष्टि rain.

f. (-वा)
The uvula or soft palate.
E.
सुधा nectar or water, श्रु to distil, अप् and टाप् affs.

m. (-तिः)
1 The moon.
2 Sacrifice, oblation.
3 A lotus.
E.
सुधा nectar, सूति birth, production.

mfn. (-न्दः-न्दी-न्दं)
Shedding ambrosia.
E.
सुधा, and स्यन्द what sheds.

m. (-रः)
GARUḌA, the bird and vehicle of VIṢṆU.
E.
सुधा nectar, and हर who steals; having on one occasion stolen the moon for the sake of the Amṛta which was to be communicated to the serpent children of KADRU, in consideration of which his mother VINATĀ was to be released from a state of servitude to KADRU, the wife, as well as herself, of the sage KAŚYAPA.

m. (-हृत्)
GARUḌA.
E.
सुधा nectar, and हृत् taking, stealing; see the last.

mf. (-तिः-तिः)
An axe.
E.
सु well, धि to hold, क्तिन् aff.; more correctly स्वधितिः.

m. (-धीः)
1 A Paṇḍita, a learned man or teacher.
2 An intelligent person.
E.
सु well, ध्यै to think, aff. क्विप्.

m. (-वः)
DHANVANTARI, the physician of Svarga.
f. (-वा)
Chebulic myrobalan, (Terminalia chebula.)
E.
सुधा nectar, and उद्भव produced.
